stubs.name: DateToString
stubs.declaration:
FUNCTION DateToString : STRING
VAR_INPUT
    In : DATE;
END_VAR
END_FUNCTION
stubs.note: Omron instruction that turns a DATE into text such as '2000-01-01'. The body is left empty because the exact format is not reproduced here; the stub returns an empty string.

stubs.name: DtToString
stubs.declaration:
FUNCTION DtToString : STRING
VAR_INPUT
    In : DATE_AND_TIME;
END_VAR
END_FUNCTION
stubs.note: Omron instruction that turns a DATE_AND_TIME into text. The body is left empty, so the stub returns an empty string.

stubs.name: g_console
stubs.note: The JiecUnit README says test results are written to the global variable g_console. Its type Console_t is defined in the library.

stubs.name: g_jiectest
stubs.note: Global JiecTest_t instance (the test registry). It is passed as self to the JiecTest_* functions, and the code reads its num_of_tests member.

stubs.name: g_jiectestnames
stubs.note: Global table of test names, read by index when tests are registered.

stubs.name: LrealToString
stubs.note: Parameters are taken from the call sites. The formatting rules are not documented here, so the body is empty.

stubs.name: NumToDecString
stubs.note: Turns an integer into a decimal string. The real Omron input accepts any integer type; LINT is used here so that both DINT and UDINT arguments widen to it. The body is empty.

stubs.name: TimeToMicroSec
stubs.declaration:
FUNCTION TimeToMicroSec : DINT
VAR_INPUT
    IN : TIME;
END_VAR
END_FUNCTION
stubs.note: Not found in the Omron manual index. The DINT return type follows how the call site uses the result. The body is left empty.

stubs.name: TimeToNanoSec
stubs.note: Omron instruction that returns a TIME value in nanoseconds as LINT. RuSTy stores TIME as nanoseconds, so TIME_TO_LINT gives exactly that value.

stubs.name: TodToString
stubs.declaration:
FUNCTION TodToString : STRING
VAR_INPUT
    In : TIME_OF_DAY;
END_VAR
END_FUNCTION
stubs.note: Omron instruction that turns a TIME_OF_DAY into text. The body is left empty, so the stub returns an empty string.

stubs.name: _sSOCKET
stubs.declaration:
TYPE _sSOCKET :
STRUCT
    Handle : UINT;
END_STRUCT
END_TYPE
stubs.note: Omron socket structure. The real one also has SrcAdr and DstAdr members of type _sSOCKET_ADDRESS; they are left out because the call sites only declare variables of this type.
